# ScribeCat 0.25.3

## Fixed
- Keep PDF zoom anchored to the pointer/viewport instead of jumping toward the top-left corner.
- Make desktop drag-to-pan work reliably while preserving PDF text selection.
- Keep the PDF minimap fixed while scrolling the zoomed page.
- Make the zoom button reset reliably from every zoom level.
- Keep slider-based zoom centered on the current viewport.

## Docker
- Publish the same 0.25.3 frontend and server build to GHCR.
- Set the Server Edition Compose default to `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.3`.
